title: FBI TSC BAE-to-IntelliWare award sequence — depth 5
summary: A later active IntelliWare award supersedes the earlier classification of BAE as the current final TSC intelligence-analysis prime; the exact corrective or replacement mechanism remains unresolved.

sources.title: Agile Defense Announces $145m Million Intelligence Analysis Contract
Agile Defense Wins $145M Contract for FBI Threat Screening Center
Agile Defense beats out 6 to win $145M FBI TSC Intelligence Analysis Services contract

data.question: How does the later IntelliWare TSC award change the classification of BAE's 2025 award and the search for AI-RFI respondents?
data.method: Cross-award identifier comparison, official company announcement review, award-team enumeration and transaction-history collection design.
data.scope: Public award and company records reviewed through 2026-08-02.
findings: BAE received initial TSC Analysis Services task order 15F06725F0001209 in 2025 and a separate bridge order.
IntelliWare Systems later received TSC Intelligence Analysis Services order 15F06726F0000362 under a different parent IDV.
Both long-term award records publicly report seven offers and closely matching TSC intelligence-analysis scope.
Agile Defense calls the IntelliWare award a $145 million single-award contract supporting the expanded all-threats mission.
The current public award record identifies IntelliWare as the active recipient.
Agile Defense publicly credited seven named people on the award team.
No reviewed record states the legal or acquisition mechanism connecting the BAE and IntelliWare awards.
No reviewed record establishes that either company responded to FBI-TSC-AIE.
conclusions: Classify IntelliWare as the current active TSC Intelligence Analysis Services awardee.
Classify BAE as the initial 2025 awardee and bridge recipient, not the unqualified current final prime.
Treat a replacement or corrective sequence as a strong inference while keeping its mechanism not established.
Use transaction histories and procurement records to resolve the sequence and all seven offerors.
limitations: No protest docket, corrective-action notice, termination record, cancellation memorandum or source-selection chronology was recovered.
Public award values can reflect ceilings and current obligations at different times.
Company award-team credits do not identify exact contract functions.
unresolved: Exact disposition of BAE task order 15F06725F0001209.
Whether the same seven offerors participated in both actions.
IntelliWare key personnel, subcontractors and transition team.
Any response by BAE, IntelliWare or Agile Defense to FBI-TSC-AIE.
